title: Daily dynamic assessment and modelling of intersession processes in ambulatory psychotherapy: A proof of concept study
limitations: - Small sample size; - Limited generalizability due to data availability and sampling bias; - Single-item scales for emotions may lack psychometric rigor; - Potential for measurement effects influencing ISP frequency and intensity
notes: The study did not report preregistration. Code for analysis is declared available, but data availability is not explicitly stated. The authors suggest future studies should use larger, more balanced datasets to examine causal roles of intersession processes.
